sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Absolute Poverty**: Measured with respect to an **Absolute Poverty Line (APL)**, representing the minimum income/consumption expenditure required to secure basic human needs.
• **Relative Poverty**: Compares the lowest segment of a population (e.g., bottom 20%) with the wealthiest segment; measures **inequality** rather than sheer deprivation.
• **Income vs. Capability Approach**: Shifting from unidimensional monetary poverty (calorie intake/expenditure) to Amartya Sen's **Capability Approach** (focusing on freedom to achieve well-being).
• **Poverty Line Basket (PLB)**: The goods and services (food, clothing, fuel, education, health) priced to determine the poverty threshold by bodies like the **NSSO**.

items.title: Major Geographical Distribution / Regional Hubs
items.content:
• **Inter-state Disparities**: Higher multidimensional poverty concentration in central and eastern India (Bihar, Jharkhand, Meghalaya, Uttar Pradesh).
• **Urban vs. Rural Divide**: Rural poverty remains structurally higher due to disguised unemployment and monsoon dependency, though urban poverty is fueled by informal sector vulnerabilities.

items.title: Challenges, Reforms & Forward Strategy
items.content:
• **Bottlenecks / Issues**: Outdated consumption expenditure data (delayed Household Consumption Expenditure Surveys), exclusion errors in welfare delivery.
• **Policy Interventions**: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), PM-Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY), MGNREGA, Ayushman Bharat for capability enhancement.

items.title: Mnemonic for Chronological Poverty Committees
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym / Phrase**: "**A**ll **L**abours **T**ry **R**ight"
• **Decoded Meaning**: **A**lagh (1979) -> **L**akdawala (1993) -> **T**endulkar (2009) -> **R**angarajan (2014).
• **Prelims Exam Value**: Instantly solves chronological ordering questions in UPSC Prelims.

items.title: Retention Rule of Thumb
items.content: • **Core Formula / Rule**: Tendulkar = MRP (Mixed Reference Period, 365/30 days); Rangarajan = MMRP (Modified Mixed Reference Period, adding 7-day recall for select items).

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC frequently asks whether the Tendulkar Committee completely eliminated calorie norms. Trap! It did not discard calories entirely; rather, it decoupled the poverty line from a specific calorie norm, ensuring that consumption expenditure baskets implicitly contained required calories.
Mains Value Addition: Quote Amartya Sen's capability approach ('Poverty is not merely lack of income, but lack of real opportunities') and UNDP's MPI dimensions to fetch stellar marks in GS-3.

keyTakeaways: Poverty measurement has evolved from pure calorie intake (Alagh) to multi-item consumption baskets (Tendulkar/Rangarajan) and modern deprivations (MPI).
Relative poverty addresses income inequality, whereas absolute poverty measures minimum sustenance threshold.
NITI Aayog's National MPI provides localized, actionable district-level data crucial for targeted social sector interventions.
